title: Page 3
content_zh:
“谢谢……谢谢您告诉我这些……”忍住悲伤，范蕙怡尽量撑起稳定的语气对徐雪龄说。
“我今天就不进公司了。”徐雪龄接着对她交代。“家族的人都在这边，虽然他现在在手术室我们也不能做什么，但总是——”
“我懂，公司的事我会处理。”
“嗯，那就这样了，有什么情况我会再跟你说。”
“谢谢。”
挂上电话以后，范蕙怡并没有如承诺的把工作做好，一整天她都浑浑噩噩，紧盯着电话，期待着却又生怕下一秒听到不好的消息。
下班时间已经过了很久，她却还不敢离开公司，依旧守着电话。
这样做实在没什么意义，她在哪里都能接电话，徐士凯也不会因为她守在这里就复原得更好。她只是不能克制自己去想，万一进电梯、万一走到捷运地下街，没接到电话怎么办？
回拨就好了——这么简单明了的答案，她一向自诩冷静聪明的脑袋居然连想都没想过。
深夜十一点，等待许久的电话终于响起。
“董事！”依然是响了一声就立刻接起来，范蕙怡的声音甚至因为紧张而微微沙哑。
“刚开完刀，目前暂时是没有生命危险了。”
范蕙怡颓然坐倒在椅子里，这时才注意到自己的身体有多紧绷，甚至都可以感觉到肌肉疼痛了。
“麻醉还没退，现在就让他休息，再看他明天早上的情况。”
“我知道了，谢谢您告诉我。”
“你还在公司？”
“嗯。”
电话那头的徐雪龄叹口气。“我就知道。好了，你别操心了，快回去睡吧！我也要回家了，晚上就留……呃，孙小姐说她要留下来等士凯醒过来。”
孙小姐——她想起了被报纸拍到跟徐士凯约会的金控千金正是姓孙。
蓦然间，宛如一桶冰水兜头淋下，让范蕙怡清醒过来。

对了，他的事情已经不用她来操心，已经有另外一个人会陪在他身边了。
“那很好。”她听到自己淡淡的对徐雪龄说，冷静得连她都想为自己拍手喝采。“董事也请您早点休息。”
挂上电话，她嘲笑今天一整天像个笨蛋似的紧张的自己。
不是说分手以后就不能关心对方，只是他的好坏都与你无关了。
能陪在他身边，有权分享他所有喜怒哀乐的人，已不是她了。
第二天范蕙怡上班的时候已经整理好心情，昨天的事情帮助她更加厘清自己的立场跟状况。
分手——这个事实也更清楚明白的摊在眼前。原来就是这么一回事，从此两人的生活有如交叉线，往完全不同的方向前进，再没有交会。
这体认让她心痛，不过她已经很习惯去忍耐那种痛苦，所以没什么的，她告诉自己。
又是新的一天，她依然做着一成不变的工作，只是今天更忙，要把昨天心神不宁的状况下做的工作全都再检查一遍。
董事迟迟没有进办公室，虽然不正常，但也很好理解，毕竟昨天家族发生了那样的大事。
她没有想太多，不过在接近中午的时候，突然接到董事的电话。
“蕙怡！你快点过来医院！”
她还没来得及打招呼，徐雪龄急切的声音就传进耳里。
“怎么了？”
“情况很复杂啦！唉，你过来再说。”
听到这种话反而让范蕙怡更慌张，好不容易平静下来的心情也因此起了波澜。
“是他的状况有变化吗？”
“身体是还好，可是士凯有些怪怪的，他一直嚷着要见你，总之……就麻烦你尽快过来一趟吧！”
抱着满腹的狐疑跟隐隐的不安，范蕙怡还是来到了医院。不用问徐士凯的病房在哪里，徐家的管家已经在医院门口等她。
徐家所有人都守在病房，虽然是头等病房，那么多人也显得拥挤。徐氏创办人、徐士凯的父母、亲戚，这些人都是公司重要的董事或主管，范蕙怡每个都认识，交往的那段时间也多少跟这些人相处过，所以她一一点头致意。

然后她看见孙小姐，跟照片中一样的美丽，但是她现在瞪着自己的表情却充满妒恨，让她稍稍有些讶异。
照理说她没有必要对一个小人物那么明显的表现出好恶。
现在是什么情形？
还没来得及问，她就被热切的男性呼唤声给夺走注意。
“蕙怡！”躺在病床上的徐士凯虽然全身裹了不少纱布，脸色也有些苍白，可是那双晶亮深黑的双眼却因为看到她而显得精神奕奕。
她走到病床前，尽管给自己打过预防针，可看到他受伤的模样，心还是一阵阵的疼。
“你……还好吧？”她的声音干哑无比，只希望不要泄露出太多感情。
她本来想礼貌的说声早日康复，却突然被他没包纱布的左手抓住了。
她吓了一跳，要挣脱却又抽不回手，正愕然的时候，床上的男人用充满爱意的眼神看着她。
“怎么现在才来？我受伤了你不是应该守在我身边吗？我醒来第一个看到的人不是应该是你吗？”
这充满委屈的控诉让她一下子反应不过来，只能愣愣的看着他。他英俊的脸孔有着她曾经再熟悉不过的表情，那宛如看着最爱的女人的温柔表情……热恋时他总是这样看着她。
她的喉咙干涩，好像被什么梗住了。
不要再这样看她，他们明明就分手了，明明就已经不是那种关系了。
“为什么我得在你身边？”他的问题根本就莫名其妙。
“什么为什么？”他微微不满意的皱起眉。“你是我的女朋友啊！”
“才、才不——”
她还没说完就被一旁的徐雪龄扯扯衣角，她转身，看到徐雪龄一脸尴尬又无奈的表情。
“那个……我说复杂的情况就是这个——士凯好像丧失了某部分的记忆。”
第2章(1)
一年前。

范蕙怡从小就知道自己不是那种会引起别人注意的人，她不像妹妹，长得漂亮嘴又甜，容易得到大人的赞赏。妈妈就曾经好几次当着她的面说她的脾气古怪，她不是古怪，只是不善于表达，也说不出那些讨好大人的话。
她唯一的优点是认真。认真的念书、认真的打工，大学毕业以后到一家国内知名的家族企业集团工作，担任其中一位董事的助理。
她的认真终于得到了回馈，她的上司仰赖她，她的薪水在同学中算高的……但尽管如此，妈妈似乎还是觉得高职毕业以后就无所事事在家，每天只想着参加电视台选秀节目当上明星的妹妹比她要好多了。
身为单亲家庭的长女，虽然她早就扛起家中的经济重担，但妈妈总觉得她这样供养着母亲跟无业的妹妹是理所当然的事情。
“有一天妹妹当了大明星，妈妈就一辈子生活无虞了。”
妈老是抱着妹妹这么说。
范蕙怡面无表情的在旁边听，没有说什么，她已经学会不去反驳，因为说出现实状况并非她们想的那么简单，只会换来妈妈跟妹妹的不开心，又要说她的个性阴沉不讨喜了。
她搬出家里，自己在外面分期付款买了一间小套房，每个月仍固定把薪水的一半拿给妈妈，得到她想要的平静。
她只是一个平凡的上班族，每天过着一成不变的日子。
平凡没有什么不好，但总有一些时候，她的心里会有点小小的动摇，会希望自己不是那么平凡的人……
台上那个代表公司主持新品发表会，正接受记者提问的男人，是公司第三代中最为耀眼的一颗明星。这种人的存在简直就是上帝偏心的证明，完美的外貌、傲人的学历、精明的头脑、显赫的家世，徐士凯拥有一切让人艳羡的条件。
content_en:
"Thank you... thank you for telling me this..." Holding back her sadness, Fan Huiyi tried her best to speak to Xu Xueling in a stable tone.
"I won't enter the company today." Xu Xueling continued to explain to her. "The family members are all here. Although we can't do anything with him in the operating room now, we always--"
"I understand, I will handle the company's affairs."
"Well, that's it. I'll tell you if anything happens."
"Thank you."
After hanging up the phone, Fan Huiyi did not do the job as promised. She was confused all day long, staring at the phone, expecting but fearing that she would hear bad news the next second.
It's been a long time since she got off work, but she still didn't dare to leave the company and still stayed on the phone.
There is really no point in doing this. She can answer the phone anywhere, and Xu Shikai will not recover better just because she stays here. She just couldn't restrain herself from thinking, what if she got into the elevator or walked to the subway underground mall and didn't receive the call?
Just call it back - such a simple and clear answer, she has never even thought about it in her calm and smart mind.
At eleven o'clock in the evening, the long-awaited phone finally rang.
"Director!" She answered immediately after the ringing. Fan Huiyi's voice was even slightly hoarse due to nervousness.
"I just had the surgery, and it's not life-threatening for the time being."
Fan Huiyi slumped down in the chair. Only then did she notice how tight her body was, and she could even feel muscle pain.
"The anesthesia hasn't worn off yet. Let him rest now and see how he goes in the morning."
"I know, thank you for telling me."
"Are you still in the company?"
"Yeah."
Xu Xueling on the other end of the phone sighed. "I knew it. Okay, don't worry about it, go back to sleep! I'm going home too, so I'll stay here tonight... uh, Miss Sun said she would stay until Shikai wakes up."
Miss Sun - She remembered that the daughter of a finance company who was photographed dating Xu Shikai in the newspaper was named Sun.
Suddenly, it was like a bucket of ice water pouring down her head, causing Fan Huiyi to wake up.
By the way, she no longer has to worry about his affairs, there is already another person who will be by his side.
"That's good." She heard herself say to Xu Xueling calmly, so calmly that even she wanted to applaud herself. "The director also asks you to take a rest early."
After hanging up the phone, she laughed at herself for being nervous like an idiot all day.
It doesn't mean that you can't care about the other person after breaking up, but whether he is good or bad has nothing to do with you.
The person who can be by his side and have the right to share all his joys and sorrows is no longer her.
Fan Huiyi had already sorted out her mood when she went to work the next day. What happened yesterday helped her clarify her position and situation more clearly.
Breaking up - this fact is also more clearly laid out in front of you. It turned out that this was the case. From then on, the two people's lives were like cross lines, heading in completely different directions, and they never intersected again.
The realization hurt her, but she was used to enduring that kind of pain, so it was okay, she told herself.
It's another new day, and she is still doing the same work, but she is busier today and has to go over all the work she did yesterday while she was restless.
The director has not entered the office for a long time. Although it is abnormal, it is understandable. After all, such a big event happened in the family yesterday.
She didn't think too much, but when it was close to noon, she suddenly received a call from the director.
"Hui Yi! Come to the hospital quickly!"
Before she could say hello, Xu Xueling's urgent voice reached her ears.
"What's wrong?"
"The situation is very complicated! Come here and talk about it later."
Hearing this kind of words made Fan Huiyi even more panicked, and her mood that had finally calmed down was also disturbed.
"Has his condition changed?"
"My body is fine, but Shikai is a little weird.He has been clamoring to see you. Anyway... I would like you to come over as soon as possible! "
Full of doubts and vague uneasiness, Fan Huiyi came to the hospital. There was no need to ask where Xu Shikai's ward was. The housekeeper of the Xu family was already waiting for her at the entrance of the hospital.
Everyone in the Xu family stayed in the ward. Even though it was a first-class ward, it seemed crowded with so many people. The founder of the Xu family, Xu Shikai's parents and relatives, these people are all important directors or managers of the company. Fan Huiyi knows each of them and has been with these people to some extent during their relationship, so she nodded and greeted them one by one.
Then she saw Miss Sun, who was as beautiful as in the photo, but the expression she was glaring at her now was full of jealousy, which made her a little surprised.
Logically speaking, there is no need for her to show her likes and dislikes to a little person so obviously.
What is the situation now?
Before she could ask, she was distracted by an eager male call.
"Hui Yi! "Xu Shikai, who was lying on the hospital bed, was wrapped in a lot of gauze and his face was a little pale, but his bright and dark eyes were full of energy because of seeing her.
She walked to the hospital bed. Even though she had been vaccinated, her heart still ached when she saw his injured appearance.
"Are you... okay? "Her voice was extremely dry and hoarse, and she just hoped not to reveal too much emotion.
She originally wanted to politely say get well soon, but she was suddenly caught by his left hand without gauze.
She was startled and tried to break away but couldn't pull her hand back. When she was stunned, the man on the bed looked at her with eyes full of love.
"Why did you come now? I'm hurt, shouldn't you stay by my side? Shouldn't you be the first person I see when I wake up? "
This accusation full of grievances made her unable to react at once, and she could only look at him blankly. His handsome face had an expression she was all too familiar with, a gentle expression like looking at the woman she loved most... He always looked at her like this when he was passionately in love.
Her throat was dry, as if something was choking her.
Stop looking at her like this. They clearly broke up and their relationship is no longer that kind of relationship.
"Why do I have to be by your side? "His question was simply baffling.
"What why? He frowned slightly dissatisfied. "You are my girlfriend!" "
"Ta-I don't-"
Before she could finish speaking, Xu Xueling tugged at the corner of her clothes. She turned around and saw an embarrassed and helpless expression on Xu Xueling's face.
"That... I said the complicated situation is this - Shikai seems to have lost some part of his memory. "
Chapter 2(1)
a year ago.
Fan Huiyi has known since she was a child that she is not the kind of person who would attract other people's attention. Unlike her sister, she is pretty and has a sweet mouth, and can easily be praised by adults. Her mother had told her several times that she had a weird temper in front of her. She was not weird, but she was not good at expressing herself and could not say things to please adults.
Her only advantage is that she is serious. I studied hard and worked hard. After graduating from college, I worked for a well-known domestic family business group as an assistant to one of the directors.
Her earnestness was finally rewarded, her boss relied on her, and her salary was relatively high among her classmates... But despite this, her mother still seemed to think that her sister, who had nothing to do at home after graduating from a vocational college, and only thought about participating in TV talent shows and becoming a star every day, was much better than her.
As the eldest daughter of a single-parent family, although she had already shouldered the financial burden of the family, her mother always felt that it was natural for her to support her mother and her unemployed sister.
"One day my sister will become a big star, and my mother will have no worries for the rest of her life. "
Mom always says this while holding her sister in her arms.
Fan Huiyi listened expressionlessly and didn't say anything. She had learned not to refute, because telling the reality was not as simple as they thought, and would only change her mother's situation.I am not happy with my sister, and I have to say that her personality is gloomy and unpleasant.
She moved out of her home and bought a small apartment on her own in installments. She still gave half of her salary to her mother every month to get the peace she wanted.
She is just an ordinary office worker, living the same life every day.
There is nothing wrong with being ordinary, but there will always be times when her heart will be a little shaken and she will wish that she is not such an ordinary person...
The man on stage who was hosting a new product launch on behalf of the company and was taking questions from reporters was the most dazzling star among the company's third generation. The existence of such a person is simply proof of God's favoritism. With perfect appearance, impressive academic qualifications, shrewd mind, and prominent family background, Xu Shikai has all the enviable conditions.
